common: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE standalone sculptural 3D WORD for a designer portfolio marquee. The TYPOGRAPHY ITSELF is the entire object: every letter is a separately modeled, thick, softly rounded tactile solid with visibly curved side surfaces and nuanced glossy studio reflections. Editorial CGI / experimental graphic design, playful modern object-like letterforms, sophisticated. Render the exact supplied name as readable bold sans-serif, natural spacing, ONE horizontal line, nearly frontal mild three-quarter perspective. High legibility at small website sizes. Completely transparent alpha surrounding and BETWEEN letters and in every letter counter. Nothing behind the letters. No official logo, no plaque, NO badge, NO capsule, NO backing, NO background shape, NO keychain, NO rings, NO hardware, NO frame, no platform, no floor, no glow surrounding the word, no labels, no extra words. Fully visible complete word with modest transparent safe margin. Mostly one color, broad restrained white reflections, soft studio lighting, clearly modeled 3D volume rather than layered flat extrusion.
